Subject: Silverline POC — mutual plan, roles & kickoff options

Thanks again for your time today — great to meet the Silverline team. Quick recap and a proposed trial cadence so we can align on expectations and lock a kickoff date. I attached a one‑page success criteria and a mutual action plan workbook for quick edits.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary goal: prove we can serve Silverline's chat-to-action flows with <250ms 95th latency and stable throughput for peak windows (target ~10 qps).
- Data constraints: test data will be synthetic + scrubbed production subset; data must remain in customer VPC for the Private deployment test.
- Success criteria: latency SLO (95th <250ms), throughput baseline (10 qps sustained for 15m), top‑k response relevance >= 85% on your eval set, and no PII leakage on retention checks.

Proposed 3‑week POC timeline (compact):
- Week 0 (Kickoff, Day 0): Environment & access, finalize success criteria, security questionnaire kickoff. Owners: Kimberly (Redwood), Anna (Silverline).
- Week 1 (Baseline + Ingest): Baseline performance with synthetic traffic; integrate SDK and verify tokenization/limits. Owners: Marissa (Redwood eng), Jorge (Silverline eng).
- Week 2 (Integration + Guardrails): Run customer eval set, iterate prompt templates, enable KV prefix caching. Owners: Monica (Redwood CS), Jorge.
- Week 3 (Readout & Next Steps): Final readout, handoff plan for next phase, pricing/practical production path. Owners: Kimberly & Anna.

Key asks from Silverline to enable the schedule:
1) Sandbox account + minimum test dataset by next Tue (2027-06-08).
2) SOC2 + network contact for VPC peering (if Private) — Karthik, can you confirm items needed?
3) 1hr kickoff slot preference next week — propose Wed 2027-06-09 10:00–11:00 PDT.

Next steps I can action now: update the Mutual Action Plan with owners and upload to the shared Drive; schedule kickoff upon your confirmation.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. Jorge and I reviewed the success criteria and the timeline looks reasonable. A few clarifications from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

- Compliance: We prefer Private deployment for the test because some of our logs will include account identifiers that policy requires remain in our VPC. Can you confirm Redwood's typical VPC peering window?
- Availability window: Our Eng team is mostly available mornings PT; Wed 2027-06-09 10:00 PDT works for a kickoff.
- Evaluation set: We'll provide a 2k‑utterance scrubbed set by EOD Mon 2027-06-07. Is CSV okay?

Also, can you confirm whether the latency target is measured with the KV cache warmed or cold? We want to make sure the success criteria are aligned to the traffic pattern we expect in production (burst + steady).

On the Mutual Action Plan — we'll add our owners to the workbook and flag any items that need longer lead times.

Cheers,
Anna Li
Director of ML Engineering
Silverline Systems
